source_conclusions.topic: Absolute native raw offsets and bounds
source_conclusions.evidence: candidate core lib.rs:2062-2085,2359-2384; selected encoding.rs:948-954,1041-1050; core lib.rs:1200-1205,1287-1293
source_conclusions.conclusion: The existing matcher excludes fragments, multiple sources, anchors, non-UTF-8, conversions and raw-encoded names, then verifies the complete exact spelling and token limit. Both native_utf8_byte_index and position(end).byte_index return raw_index in that state; byte_count equals end. BOM offsets remain included. Accepted input is bounded by min(max_total_bytes,isize::MAX), so the retained range fits the accepted source. No arena capacity threshold is needed for a scalar range.

source_conclusions.topic: Fallibility and ownership after stack pop
source_conclusions.conclusion: account_source(end) completes before name detachment and updates accounted_raw. prepare_end_frame moves the existing tracked String, performs no allocation or callback, and only changes stack/frame/closed_root. Source state is unchanged until consume; its identical accounting query returns zero before ordinary Unicode coordinate advancement and scan retirement. Frame publication and last_position follow the existing delivery path. Failed accounting leaves stack/raw untouched; removed token allocation intentionally changes allocation scheduling.

Generation rejection precedes C mode. C mode, enabled input context and the original no-DTD/no-shared-tables/no-namespace-undo guards additionally restrict the shortcut. The entire old token-copy/parse/raw-publication tail is unchanged for every fallback. native_raw.start participates in retention before subsequent feeds; native storage is not compacted by consume, while Separate retains original raw bytes independently. Only the validated range is decoded by current_raw, preserving readable raw across malformed later suffixes and failed growth.

source_conclusions.evidence: selected C lib.rs:1330-1445,2279-2310; candidate C tests.rs:1871-1965
source_conclusions.conclusion: C End dispatch still owns the detached String outside parser borrows, charges callback work before its fallible terminator, and preserves selected allocator/recycling/default-copy behavior. Busy guards continue to reject recursive parse/reset/free. The new raw-context helper ends its borrowed slice before nested operations; callback copies are owned. The fixture renews userdata after external State inspection before Resume, and verifies raw/index/count/line/column before and after child/default/stop operations.

source_conclusions.evidence: candidate core lib.rs:5205-5346; allocation.rs:957-1032; C tests.rs:1871-1965
source_conclusions.conclusion: The new matrix proves actual native_raw selection versus generic/context-disabled/foreign-frame/whitespace/namespace-scope fallback, unchanged raw and scratch owners on the selected path, moved End name identity, BOM/Unicode/CR coordinates and ordinary handoff. Existing retention tests preserve original Text cases and add a 4103-byte Unicode End across compaction and malformed/incomplete suffixes. The allocation sweep adds End range retention for native growth and Separate while preserving injected-failure, sticky-error, selected-routing and zero-leak checks. The C fixture covers n, Unicode and 4097-byte names with DefaultCurrent, child parse, Stop/Resume and rejected reset/free.
